approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: Body and Subject routing accept Request for Information and Submission aliases, but filename fallback currently accepts only RFI and Submittal.
Scanned or otherwise textless files named Request for Information No. 0042 or Submission No. 23-01 therefore remain UNKNOWN.
Extend the existing bounded filename fallback patterns and reuse the current identifier normalizer; add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Offline parser and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Full-name workflow filename routing
objective: Route textless or generic-content files by full-name Request for Information and Submission filenames exactly as their RFI and Submittal aliases are routed.
